context: Two siblings split chores and discuss tomorrow's plans
purpose: Teach: 怪我/平日/うどん/パーセント/引く/映画館/食堂/出勤

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お兄ちゃん、明日は平日だけど、家事の分担どうする？
lines.en: Hey bro, tomorrow's a weekday, but how should we split the chores?
lines.style: Casual younger sister, slightly bossy but friendly tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うーん、俺は早めの出勤だから、朝のゴミ出しと洗濯はお前に頼みたいんだけど。
lines.en: Hmm, I have to leave for work early, so I want you to handle the morning trash and laundry.
lines.style: Older brother, slightly tired, negotiating casually with sister.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えー、ずるい。じゃあ夜の食器洗いはお兄ちゃんね。七十パーセントくらいお兄ちゃんの担当でいいでしょ。
lines.en: What, no fair. Then you do the dishes at night. Like seventy percent of the load should be yours.
lines.style: Teen sister pushing back playfully, half-joking complaint.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 七十はちょっと多いから、そこは線を引くぞ。半分でいいって。あ、そういえば昨日バイトで指に怪我しちゃってさ、皿洗いちょっとキツいんだよ。
lines.en: Seventy is a bit much, so I'm drawing the line there. Half is fine. Oh by the way, I cut my finger at my part-time job yesterday, so washing dishes is kinda rough.
lines.style: Brother bargaining firmly, showing minor wound for sympathy.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うわ、大丈夫？絆創膏貼っときなよ。じゃあ明日の晩ごはん、私が作るからうどんでいい？
lines.en: Whoa, are you okay? Put a bandage on it. Then I'll cook dinner tomorrow — is udon fine with you?
lines.style: Sister suddenly caring, switching to motherly tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うどん最高。あ、明日仕事終わったら映画館行かない？新しいやつ観たくてさ。
lines.en: Udon sounds great. Hey, wanna hit the movie theater tomorrow after I get off work? There's a new film I want to see.
lines.style: Brother brightening up, casually inviting sister out together.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いいね！じゃあ私は学校の食堂で軽く食べてから直接駅で待ち合わせしよう。
lines.en: Sounds good! Then I'll grab a light meal at the school cafeteria and meet you straight at the station.
lines.style: Sister excited, planning logistics enthusiastically with brother.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 了解。じゃあ俺、明日早いからもう寝るわ。おやすみ。
lines.en: Got it. Alright, I've got an early start tomorrow, so I'm heading to bed. Night.
lines.style: Brother wrapping up casually, tired but content.
